room_rent.display: Single Private Room or 1% of SI/day
room_rent.note: Per schedule: Single Private Room OR up to 1% of SI/day; Room Rent Modification available as optional. Multi-variant product (Hospitalization / Operation Mediclaim / etc.) - baselined to the comprehensive hospitalization variant

icu.note: Per schedule: up to 2% of SI/day or 'no sub-limit'

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay per claim ONLY if entry age 61+ at first policy; no co-pay for younger entrants

sub_limits.note: VERIFY - some procedure sub-limits per schedule

ped_waiting.note: Excl01: PED excluded until 36 months; reducible to 24 months via Optional Benefit 8 (Reduction of PED Wait period)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Excl02: 24 months; specific waiting applicable only for Operation Mediclaim variant

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB: +50% SI after 1st claim-free year, +25% 2nd, +25% 3rd, cumulative max 100%

restoration.note: No inbuilt restoration in base; Unlimited Automatic Recharge available only as Optional Benefit 3 (requires SI >= Rs 5L)

domiciliary.note: VERIFY - domiciliary cover not clearly confirmed

ayush.note: AYUSH Treatments listed among covered benefits

ambulance.note: Road Ambulance Cover; Air Ambulance optional. VERIFY ₹ limit

modern_treatments.note: Advance technology methods incl. robotic surgery

global_cover.note: Benefit 12 Global Coverage is inbuilt but only available if chosen SI is Rs 100L or more

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded; mandatory 20% co-pay for 61+ entrants; restoration only as paid optional; global cover needs SI >= Rs 100L
